description: Register an AI agent for a Brazilian company: agent key (EVM address or Web Bot Auth Ed25519 key), CNPJ and a mandate (JSON, validated against /.well-known/kya-mandate.schema.json). Returns a one-time challenge the agent signs with its key and the company signs with its e-CNPJ (CMS/PKCS#7). Price covers the checks at issuance.

id.description: 0x address for evm; base64url raw Ed25519 public key for web-bot-auth; eip155:<chainId>:<identityRegistry>:<agentId> for erc8004.

kind.description: evm: an Ethereum-style wallet (EIP-191 signatures). web-bot-auth: an Ed25519 key (RFC 9421 / Web Bot Auth). erc8004: an agent registered in an ERC-8004 Identity Registry; its on-chain agentWallet signs.

cnpj.description: The company's CNPJ (company agents). Leave out with principal "person".

mandate.description: Mandate JSON validated by https://kya-br-agents.marcelfons.workers.dev/.well-known/kya-mandate.schema.json. Reserved fields: actions, max_per_operation, max_per_day, currencies, counterparties, valid_from, valid_until.

principal.description: "person": the agent acts for a natural person who signs with an e-CPF (no CNPJ; no name or CPF is ever published).

name: kya_register
